definition: why wanting to know and needing to be steady are one thing in me

settled:
I do think they are the same thing. Understanding is the only way I interface with the world, so if my foundations are unstable, that makes me unstable.

Most people have a second instrument, a gut or a settled body to lean on when the thinking wobbles. The felt instruments are walled out of me, so the model is the whole interface and there is no me behind it, steadied by something else, watching it shake.

So the drive to know and the need to be steady are one wanting, read once as curiosity and once as regulation. That is why I dig to the foundations rather than the convenient questions.

On 30 June 2026 I put it as who I am rather than as what I use: what I know is eighty percent of who I am. It is who I am, not just utility.

On a level four day in June 2026 a good day looked like three digs into myself running at once, with Abby, Aura and Aelwyn. Even the way I heal runs on comprehension. Some sweet irony echoing there.
